chapter: Vocalese and Lambert, Hendricks and Ross
title: Six-month secret sessions with Creed Taylor, his heart operation
summary: The album took six months, he collapsed afterward, and they recorded secretly at night with Creed Taylor on a tiny budget.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: How long did the whole project take, and how long did something like – what is it? I’m trying to think – what’s on that album? I must apologize for that, because . . .
Every Day, It’s Sand, man, Down for Double, West End Blues.
Down for Double. Let’s go there.
How long did something like that take?
Days. Each one of them took days. Weeks, really.
It seems like it. There are just so many layers there in the way you just described it. It seemed like it would take months to do that project.
It took six months. At the end I came out, collapsed into a taxi, went to Bellevue Hospital, and had an operation. I almost died from my heart.
Yeah. I was very sick from self-abuse. A lot of marijuana smoking, liquor drinking, general debauchery of all kinds. I just – we stayed up 48 hours at a time and

worked day and night, non-stop. Also, it had to be done in secret, because the singers had cost $1,250 that date. So that left us $1,250 in the whole to Ampar record company, which was a new record company formed by ABC Broadcasting and Paramount Pictures. They weren’t about to spend any more than that initial twelve-fifty. But the guy that was the A&R man, making his debut in the record business, was Creed Taylor, a young kid just out of college, fresh faced, green, and innocent as a baby lamb.
Are you still in touch with him?

Oh yeah. We still talk, because we had a hand in a masterpiece. So there will always be some room for talk there. So he had to keep it secret from the company, and we had to let the engineer in on it. The place closed at 11 o’clock. The studio closed at 11. So we’d all come back at midnight, the engineer, and Dave, Annie, and I, and Creed, would come back at midnight and secretly record until 6 am.
I forget his name. I have to find that out. That should be on the back of the album. He became a co-conspirator with us to keep it from the company.
